**Surfaced 2026-05-17 by PLINY at Arc 36 v2 close + user-tier POLYBIUS QA pass.**

Three follow-ups from Arc 36 v2 (stoa--jru) shipping. None affect shipped substrate canon — all are housekeeping observations for future work.

## Item 1 — VERA probe-regex tightening (5 items)

PLINY signoff named "5 probe-regex tightening items (VERA-named, next-arc work)" without specifying inline. Items live in VERA's verdict artifact for arc-36 (under `agents/verdicts/stoa--jru/` or equivalent path). Probe-formulation concerns about regex patterns; same shape as stoa--k03 Item 2 was for Arc 35 design.md.

**Fix shape:** read VERA verdict; enumerate the 5 items; refine each in the corresponding design.md probe section. Direct-to-main user-tier housekeeping per `MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md` §18.1.

## Item 2 — Bug #40228 surveillance

DAEDALUS rev2 surfaced via WebFetch: `CronCreate durable: true` doesn't persist to `~/.claude/scheduled_tasks.json` despite documented schema. Bug filed at anthropics/claude-code#40228; OPEN since 2026-03-28.

Arc 36 design encodes `durable: true` as honest-intent (works when bug fixed without canon revision) + treats `MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md` §9 step 7 PRINCIPAL-consent re-setup as load-bearing recovery. Not Arc 36's responsibility to fix.

**Watch shape:** periodically re-check bug #40228 status. If/when fixed in a Claude Code release, the Part 2 renewal canon at op-disc §11 step 1.5 becomes more robust. No canon revision needed at fix-time; surveillance is just for awareness.

## Item 3 — Convention adoption beyond A2.5 scope (observation)

Empirical from Arc 36: all CAPTAINs + PLINY organically adopted `[from:]` tagging despite A2.5 scoping the convention to POLYBIUS-on-POLYBIUS only (80 total `[from:]` tags across 9 seat-slugs on stoa--jru). If organic adoption continues across Arcs 37-39, future arc may codify wider adoption as A2.5 scope expansion.

**Why low priority:** A2.5 hard-locked the scope intentionally. The organic adoption is informative but doesn't ship a substrate need yet — the timeline-arithmetic for radio-check / heartbeat thresholds only consumes POLYBIUS-attributed comments per §7.7 case 4. Wider adoption is style-not-substance until / unless gauntlet-pacing failure modes surface that would benefit from PLINY/CAPTAIN timeline contribution.

## Sequencing

P4. Item 1 small direct-edit work; Item 2 passive surveillance; Item 3 observation-deferred-until-pattern-confirms.
